notes.title: Front Office Football Nine: Version 9.1 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Front Office Football Nine[/h2]

[h3]Version 9.1 Update[/h3]

This update adds the ability to start a new Front Office Football universe with the 2024 Player and Coaches files. The 2023 files will still be available.

To use the new files, begin a new universe and select the 2024 Player files. They will only work with a new universe.

Please see the product documentation for other changes. Some of the data files were changed, and there are a few bug fixes.
